review: Independent model semantic backcheck accepted material faithfulness. Not fluent-speaker or local-farming approval. Keypoint 3 retains technical English edges/margins; rationale separates inspection list from adviser consultation.

keyPoints.sourceEnglish: Observe your land for a full season before major earthworks
keyPoints.sesothoDraft: Shebella setsha sa hao sehleng sohle pele o qala earthworks tse kgolo.

keyPoints.sourceEnglish: Catch and store rain, sun, and biomass before they leave your property
keyPoints.sesothoDraft: Bokella mme o boloke pula, letsatsi le biomass pele di tloha setsheng sa hao.

keyPoints.sourceEnglish: Edges and margins can be useful places to observe what grows well
keyPoints.sesothoDraft: Edges le margins di ka ba dibaka tse molemo tsa ho shebella se melang hantle.

keyPoints.sourceEnglish: Hail injury to maize depends on the storm and the crop’s growth stage
keyPoints.sesothoDraft: Tšenyo ya sefako pooneng (maize) e itshetlehile ka sefefo le boemo ba kgolo ya sejwalo.

question.sourceEnglish: A farmer wants to dig swales to harvest rainwater. What should she do first, following 'observe and interact'?
question.sesothoDraft: Molemi o batla ho cheka swales hore a bokelle metsi a pula. O lokela ho qala ka ho etsa eng, a latela molao-motheo wa observe and interact?

options.sourceEnglish: Dig immediately after the first good rain
options.sesothoDraft: Cheka hang ka mora pula ya pele e ntle.

options.sourceEnglish: Watch where water flows and pools across at least one wet season
options.sesothoDraft: Shebella moo metsi a phallang le moo a bokellanang teng nakong ya sehla se le seng sa dipula bonyane.
Kopitsa moralo wa swales wa moahisani.

options.sourceEnglish: Assume the same swale design fits every site
options.sesothoDraft: Nka hore moralo o tshwanang wa swales o loketse setsha se seng le se seng.

rationale.sourceEnglish: A wet season shows more than one storm, but observation is only a first step. Check the soil, slope, drainage and safe overflow route with a trained local adviser before digging.
rationale.sesothoDraft: Sehla sa dipula se bontsha difefo tse fetang se le seng, empa ho shebella ke mohato wa pele feela. Pele o cheka, hlahloba mobu, moepa, drainage le safe overflow route. Etsa sena le moeletsi wa lehae ya kwetlisitsweng.
